postal_system.scope: Macao local postal-system policy; not a mainland route-code, telephone prefix or postal box assignment.

identifier_namespaces.rule: Source-qualified stable street identity, not a postcode, address or building.
Exact permitted doorplate and language fields with source identity and validity; retain ranges, suffixes and ambiguity.
Separately permitted geometry with explicit civic-address relation, not a inferred unit, owner or parcel right.
Independent spatial index from reviewed coordinates; retains MO identity, never becomes CTT code or governmental grid.

stages.definition: Reviewed no-postcode, authority, rights and privacy contract with bounded reference checks and negative tests.

A current rights-cleared real Macao street/civic-address dataset with explicit scope, stable source identifiers or snapshot row identity, source Traditional Chinese/Portuguese fields, observed time, edition, validity semantics, schema and SHA-256 reproducibly produces approved immutable digest-pinned address-context artifacts and passes the actual MO AGID loader/API. Keep local postalCode null and official postal geometry none: CTT form placeholder 000000, doorplate numbers, cadastral identifiers and AGID cells are not official postcodes. House numbers and buildings require explicit permitted source records and relations, not containment, proximity or translated names. Reconcile legacy DSCC and current DSSCU authority from 2026-06-01, item-specific reproduction permission, geometry CRS/scale/topology, duplicate/range/ambiguity/privacy exceptions, transformation and real coverage validation. Synthetic tests, policy pages, HTML shells and a live reference alone never establish M2.

agid_integration.current_scope: MO address metadata and source catalog only; generic Postal Context runtime remains disabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A licensed no-postcode address-context descriptor, immutable data artifacts and actual MO loader/API verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: No official postal polygon is manufactured. Independently licensed civic/administrative geometry stays typed and source-qualified; derived/virtual products require explicit separate provenance and approval.
